name: quote-card-builder
description: Turn quotes, text, URLs, documents, and ideas into editable quote cards with guided editorial and visual review.

interface.longDescription: When a user clearly asks to proceed from a readable URL, the host reads the source, selects a strong exact quote, and opens one populated editor. The server does not fetch URLs. Missing attribution defaults to none unless the user supplied a name or the source verifies it; the neutral palette is the default. Later explicit chat edits use quote_card_builder_update_editor with the current revision, complete draft, and requested changes; the revision-checked update carries forward all unspecified choices. Drafts do not sync across devices or conversations. The global workspace and thread entrypoint remain available for users who open the plugin without a quote; they may show an editable demo that is never presented as user-supplied. Download PNG generates and saves the exact finished PNG in one action. The plugin uses the canonical renderer. If the host explicitly reports that the editor cannot mount, its model-visible headless fallback returns a preview as an explicit SVG resource and requires caller approval plus the current preview SHA-256 for production.
defaultPrompt: Open Quote Card Builder and turn this quote into a card.
Find the strongest quote in this text and open the Quote Card Builder editor.
